title: Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.14913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. translated_title: 基于上下文建模弥合模型预测任务采样中的风险近似鸿沟
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）对于自适应决策至关重要，例如鲁棒的元强化学习与域随机化，以及大语言模型（LLM）的高效后训练，在这些场景中任务通常被构建为马尔可夫决策过程或提示。所有这些设定中的一个核心瓶颈是任务选择与策略优化所需的智能体-环境交互成本。模型预测任务采样通过利用在优化历史上训练的风险预测模型来查询有信息量的任务，已成为提升样本效率的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的风险预测模型存在两类失效模式：（i）优化历史稀疏，限制了风险预测模型在整个任务空间上的泛化能力；（ii）风险近似存在一步滞后，导致随策略演化而产生有偏差的难度估计。本工作对这两类失效模式进行了形式化，并推导了滞后风险分解，从而揭示了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过上下文建模来弥合风险预测模型因优化历史稀疏和一步滞后而产生的风险近似缺陷，从而提升模型预测任务采样在强化学习与大语言模型后训练中的样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper bridges the risk approximation gaps in risk predictive models—caused by sparse optimization histories and one-step lag—via in-context modeling, thereby improving the sample efficiency of model predictive task sampling for RL and LLM post-training.
